The company is also nearing certification of the 737-10, the largest variant of the 737 MAX. Ortberg said the aircraft will be certified "very soon," although its certification is several years behind schedule.
Ortberg also sought to temper expectations for a large aircraft order from China next week, when Chinese President Xi Jinping is due to meet U.S. President Donald Trump in Washington.
